meta.title: NOSTALGIA Map v2 - merged real coordinates of every place / landmark / roof id
meta.format: {id: {name, lat, lon, confidence, source, note, from: nw|se|both, ward, merge: rule, alt?: losing candidate, district?: game district, ...researcher extras (id_kind, anchor, anchor_latlon, anchor_game_u, offset_u, fictional, palace_centroid, stadium_centre, real_site)}}
rules: tie: Tank Bund furniture follows tank_bund; manual picks; two highs <= 150 m -> midpoint; inside the game district polygon; data-cited source over estimate; scope owner (shared districts -> NW)

confidence_rules.high: from map data or several agreeing sources
